INSERT INTO crm_connections (
            organization_id,
            user_id,
            status,
            oauth_subject,
            crm_tenant_id,
            crm_user_id,
            access_token,
            refresh_token,
            token_type,
            scope,
            instance_url,
            expires_at
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            'CONNECTED'::crm_connection_status,
            $3,
            $4,
            $5,
            $6,
            $7,
            $8,
            $9,
            $10,
            now() + interval '30 minutes'
         )
